name: dsh-memory-discipline
description: Memory-usage discipline for DeepSeek Harness: a stable system-prompt policy section plus automatic hot-context fetch-and-inject at session start, generic over any configured memory tool family.

dshCompatibility.note: deepseek-harness is pre-release with no compatibility promise; re-verify against newer commits before upgrading. The runtime import @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm is an explicit dependency so linked installs resolve it from the plugin source directory; tests may still resolve @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools through the harness profile fallback.
